notes: B-2 continues the bibliography with sections 4–7: algebraic curves; algebraic theory of elliptic curves; modular schemes; and abelian varieties/abelian schemes. Twelve references are listed. The dated entries read 1948, 1959, 1936, 1949, three times 1959 for Igusa, then 1948, 1959, 1957-62 for the Bourbaki extracts, 1964 and 1965. The source gives Deuring p.32-47; Igusa p.453-476, p.436-452 and p.561-577; Grothendieck exp.232 et 236; Neron n°21; and Lang n°7. These are source bibliographical statements, not catalogue verification. Three pencil ticks point to the two Weil entries and Lang. The heading « théorie algebrique » in section 6 lacks the accent found in section 5 and is left so. A faint possible acute in the section 7 Weil title is now preferred but remains doubtful. No mathematical proof or external bibliographic check was performed.
legibility: All headings, references and numerical ranges are legible. The old mark at les and pale acute in the later Weil title remain uncertain. C preserved the uneven accenting and ticks; H has an editorial description only.
feedback: Scan 84: faint handwritten or lightly impressed accents must be distinguished from spelling normalization. The local mark, not the expected title, changes the preferred reading in abéliennes.
